_comment: Message templates from the Cisco Secure Firewall ASA syslog guide (302013/302014/302015/302016/106023), written as regexes. 'documented_examples' reproduce the template shape (connection id shared by build and teardown, duration hh:mm:ss, 'TCP FINs' reason) as shown in Cisco's ASA FAQ 116149; they are shape fixtures, not captures from a production ASA.

formats.302014: %ASA-6-302014: Teardown TCP connection (\d+) for (\w+):([\d.]+)/(\d+) to (\w+):([\d.]+)/(\d+) duration (\d+:\d{2}:\d{2}) bytes (\d+)( [A-Za-z0-9 -]+)?$
formats.302016: %ASA-6-302016: Teardown UDP connection (\d+) for (\w+):([\d.]+)/(\d+) to (\w+):([\d.]+)/(\d+) duration (\d+:\d{2}:\d{2}) bytes (\d+)$

documented_examples: Nov  3 10:00:53 asa-fw-01 %ASA-6-302014: Teardown TCP connection 8 for outside:198.51.100.80/80 to inside:10.20.10.45/51360 duration 0:00:53 bytes 2436 TCP FINs
Nov  3 10:01:02 asa-fw-01 %ASA-4-106023: Deny tcp src outside:203.0.113.88/44820 dst inside:10.20.10.5/22 by access-group "outside_access_in" [0x8f2a1b9c, 0x0]
